summary: Atlas Trinity Tech Limited, a BVI foreign private issuer, filed a 6-K reporting a September 28, 2026 securities purchase agreement with 15 purchasers for 11,750,072 ordinary shares at US$1.27 each, raising US$14,922,591.44 gross in an offshore Reg S private placement. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium was disclosed. Purchasers accepted 60-day transfer, pledge, and hedging lock-ups; the issuer must file an F-1/F-3 resale registration within 60 days of closing, terminable if closing misses the fifth trading day. Watch resale overhang and registration timing risk.
